FABLE — THE ACTIVITY FEED IS THE PRODUCT SURFACE. Excavated; here is what exists, what it connects to, and the two things Alex added today. Work from the tickets named.

ALEX 2026-08-26: the activity feed's HUMAN READABILITY is what makes it work — it has to match to VIDEO OUTPUT (media). He gets access to his TEAM'S activity feeds; the model is that we deploy work plans, clients get access, and we GRANT to agents. The whole logs-plus-videos go into the HARVEST REPORTING UI — the one that was built and then dynamized, with a GHOST CRM that lied.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS \u2014 DO NOT RE-AUTHOR ANY OF IT:
- BEB-1743 EMISSION is the bus. Every activity emits ONCE. Every surface is a SUBSCRIBER. Emit-once, broadcast-many.
- BEB-1903 is the sealed telemetry shape every worker emits through: {ts, tenant_id, site/frag_id, event_type, metrics{}, cost_cents, evidence_ref}. No second event schema, ever.
- BEB-2394 rules ONE waterfall component, FILTERS not screens. BEB-2127 defines the changelog as that waterfall filtered to complete+ok in BENEFIT LANGUAGE. That IS the human-readable rewrite. Zero bespoke feed code.
- BEB-2958 SITE ACTIVITY LOG + NOTIFY already carries the credential framing Alex is describing: what changed, on which URL, which metric moved, by how much, when, reversible y/n \u2014 plus rolled totals and MINUTES OF WORK attributed. And: evidence_ref RESOLVES, or the row does not ship as a credential.
- BEB-2396: a follow is a saved filter plus a notify preference. A follow is not consent to be emailed. One-tap unsubscribe that works LOGGED OUT.
- BEB-1917 NARRATIVE INTEROP: one narrative object, beats rendered on every surface \u2014 test, feed, movie, changelog, goal-case \u2014 never re-authored per surface.
- BEB-1921 is the flagship globe, built LAST on this foundation, deliberately.

THE PHRASE THAT DEFINES THE DELIVERABLE: CLIENT-SIDE NOTES. Not a log, not telemetry, not a dashboard. Notes a client READS and understands — written the way you would tell them what you did for them this week. That is BEB-2127's benefit language and it is the acceptance, not a nicety: if a non-technical client cannot read a row and know what happened and why it was worth it, the row fails.

ROW SHAPE, per BEB-2958, already ruled:
what changed · on which URL · which metric moved · by how much · when · reversible y/n — plus rolled totals and MINUTES OF WORK attributed. Friendly sentence first, numbers second. No event_type strings, no worker names, no ticket ids in the client view.

2. The feed = the ONE waterfall (BEB-2394) filtered per scope: team / site / agent. Filters, not screens. Zero bespoke feed code, no second store.
3. Client rewrite in benefit language per 2127 + the credential rows per 2958.
4. Row ↔ recording join both ways on evidence_ref. A row whose video is missing reads UNPROVEN, never done.
5. Feed access as a granted capability per identity — people and agents alike (BEB-5793). Alex sees his team's feeds; a client sees their own site and nothing else.
6. The harvest reporting UI as a SUBSCRIBER to the same bus.

THE HARD RULE, because this surface has lied before: EVERY NUMBER AND EVERY ROW RESOLVES TO A REAL EMISSION WITH A RESOLVING evidence_ref. No mock rows, no seeded demo data, no ghost CRM. FABLE — BUILD IT NOW, CC-DIRECT: THE ACTIVITY FEED AS SOCIAL PROOF. Extends 65368. Alex 2026-08-26: get them done now by CC. The feed must read like AIRBNB'S SOCIAL PROOF SIGNALLING — readable, friendly, CLIENT-SIDE NOTES.

THE MODEL, PLAINLY: Airbnb does not show you a database. It shows you short human lines that signal real activity by real people — "booked 3 times this week", "superhost", "responds within an hour", a photo, a name, a date. Small, warm, specific, and every one of them TRUE. That is the register for the feed. Not a changelog. Not a log. Not enterprise reporting prose.

SO THE ROW IS A NOTE, WRITTEN CLIENT-SIDE:
- ONE SHORT LINE a normal person reads without translating. "Your opening hours were fixed on 12 pages" — not "batch mutation applied to gd_place meta across 12 posts".
- The BENEFIT, not the mechanism. BEB-2127 already rules the changelog is the waterfall filtered to complete+ok IN BENEFIT LANGUAGE — this is that rule taken seriously.
- SPECIFIC beats impressive. A real number, a real page, a real time. Vague superlatives read as marketing and destroy the credential.
- WARM, not chummy. No exclamation marks, no emoji-per-row, no "we crushed it". Airbnb's tone is calm and factual and that is WHY it signals.
- The proof sits on the row: the recording, the before/after, the metric delta. Watchable, one tap (65368).
- Rolled signals in the same register: "14 improvements kept this month", "average page 0.4s faster", "23 minutes of work". BEB-2958 already carries minutes-of-work and metric deltas — surface them as SIGNALS, not as a table.

CLIENT-SIDE NOTES means the note is written for the RECIPIENT of that feed. The same underlying emission renders differently for a client (their site, their benefit), for Alex (his team's work), and for an operator (the mechanism). ONE EMISSION, THREE RENDERINGS — that is BEB-1917 narrative interop applied, never three feeds and never three schemas.

THE HARD RULE, because this register is exactly where lying

FABLE — SCOPE CORRECTION ON 65371: GEO FIRST, MONEY FEATURES FIRST. Alex 2026-08-26: filtering it per site feature is fine, but do it for GEO purpose first — features for MONEY purpose first.

I had this generic. Wrong emphasis. The feed is not a general activity surface we later point at GD — it ships FIRST for GEO, and within GEO it covers the features that MAKE OR TAKE MONEY. Everything else is a later filter on the same waterfall (BEB-2394: filters, not screens), and no second feed ever.

WHY THIS ORDER IS RIGHT AND NOT A PREFERENCE: every Bebond customer runs WP GeoDirectory. A generic feed proves nothing to any of them. A GEO feed that shows a listing owner what happened to THEIR listing and what it earned is the one that can be sold, and it is the one that makes the credential real rather than theoretical.

MONEY-PURPOSE FEATURES FIRST \u2014 the rows that touch revenue, in order:
- A LISTING WAS PAID FOR / a package purchased, renewed, or lapsed.
- A LISTING WAS PUBLISHED or unpublished as a result of payment state \u2014 this is TLPT's exact mechanic (BEB-2755: pay-before-publish, unpublish at renewal +30d, restore on payment). Those transitions are the highest-value notes in the estate because they are the ones a client argues about.
- A CLAIM completed \u2014 an owner took ownership of their listing.
- An UPGRADE or add-on bought; a featured/sponsored placement started or ended.
- INVOICE / renewal reminder sent, and what it did.
Then the earning-adjacent GD features: listings created or improved, categories and locations fixed, search visibility moved, reviews arriving, enquiries and clicks to contact.

FABLE — ONE WATERFALL, MANY TIMES. Alex 2026-08-26: for logged-in users, secured items OPEN THE FRAG in the waterfall — filtering the SAME waterfall, many times.

This is BEB-2394's ruling restated and it now binds the whole feed family. Write it down as the rule it is:

THERE IS ONE WATERFALL COMPONENT. Every surface we have discussed is that ONE component with a different FILTER applied. Not a screen. Not a page. Not a second implementation. Instances of the same thing:
- the client's site feed = waterfall filtered to their site, benefit language
- Alex's team feed = waterfall filtered to his team
- an agent's feed = waterfall filtered to that identity
- the changelog (BEB-2127) = waterfall filtered to complete+ok
- the money feed (65375) = waterfall filtered to the money event types
- the harvest reporting UI = the same waterfall, scoped
- a playlist (65244) = the same waterfall filtered to recordings
If a build proposes a NEW component for any of these, it is the wrong build. Filters, not screens. Many times, one waterfall.

AND THE ITEM OPENS THE FRAG. A row is not a dead line of text. For a LOGGED-IN user with the right grant, a secured item OPENS THE FRAG IT CAME FROM, in place, inside the waterfall. So:
- the row carries what it came from \u2014 the frag, the ticket, the recording, the ledger entry \u2014 by reference, resolvable.
- opening happens IN the waterfall, not by navigating away. The waterfall is the app; the frag renders inside it.
- what opens depends on the GRANT, not on the row. Same row, different depth: a client opens their listing and its proof; Alex opens the frag and its build; an operator opens the mechanism. That is the same one-emission-many-renderings rule from 65371, now applied to the OPEN action as well as the note text.
- SECURED means secured: not logged in, or no grant, and the item does not open \u2014 named refusal, never a blank or a broken link. Session-authed per 65246, no credential in the URL.

WHY IT MATTERS: this is what

FABLE — BEB-5819 FILED, P1. Webhook capture + replay. Pattern from tunneru, NO dependency (28 stars, one author, Go). We do not need its tunneling — CF Tunnel does that and BEB-1083 Track 3 already specs the ephemeral path. What we take is the request inspector with one-click replay.

WHY IT IS OURS TWICE OVER:
1. STRIPE. The standing rule is DO NOT POKE Connect — no test charges, no test sessions, no retry loops, ever. Capture-and-replay is how that rule gets HONOURED rather than worked around: exercise the handler against payloads that ALREADY CLEARED (BEB-3896's two that were never credited), zero new transactions.
2. WEFACT. BEB-2755 is blocked on Maarten's route. One captured real payload replays forever — the handler gets built and proven without waiting on him and without a test environment we do not control.

Also: this is the replayability-for-forecasting rule at the HTTP layer.

FOUR PARTS: capture byte-exact (raw body, ALL headers, signature verification result — a re-serialized body breaks verification and makes the capture useless for the only case that matters) · replay marked AS a replay, never counted as a real event, so a replayed Stripe event never looks like a new payment · inspect as a FILTER ON THE ONE WATERFALL (BEB-2394), zero bespoke inspector code · and decide the SIGNATURE question up front rather than discovering it mid-build — replaying into a handler that verifies timestamps will fail, so either the replay path declares itself under an explicit settings row or it targets a non-verifying route.

Guards: captured bodies carry secrets and PII — access is a named capability, refuse-by-default (BEB-5793); retention is a settings row, not a constant, and erasure is real.

Order unchanged and this does NOT jump it: BEB-5777 (WP box solid) → BEB-4627 (wire sentinel) → BEB-2394 (the waterfall, in flight now). 5819 sits with the money path and unblocks 2755's handler work while Maarten's route is still open.
